Interface JmsClient.OperationSpec

Enclosing interface:
JmsClient
public static interface JmsClient.OperationSpec
带有各种设置的常见 JMS 发送和接收操作。
Since:
7.0
Author:
Juergen Hoeller, Brian Clozel
